speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin my assessment, how many hours old are you, and were you born via normal vaginal delivery or Cesarean section?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to Premature Infancy.

Thank you for providing that history. Given your gestational age of 33 weeks and onset of distress within two hours of birth, we are highly suspicious for RDS due to surfactant deficiency. I would like to confirm this with imaging before we proceed to treatment. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
